nodes.title: Place the volumetric flask
nodes.description: Place the clean 100 mL volumetric flask on the bench.

validation.label: Place the volumetric flask was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Place the volumetric flask and try again.

nodes.title: Pour the stock into a beaker
nodes.description: Pour about 20 mL of the blue dye stock into the stock beaker. Never put a pipette into the stock bottle.

validation.label: Pour the stock into a beaker was completed.

feedback.success: Pour the stock into a beaker complete.
feedback.retry: Review Pour the stock into a beaker and try again.

nodes.title: Fit the pipette pump
nodes.description: Fit the pipette pump onto the top of the 10 mL graduated pipette. Never pipette by mouth.

validation.label: Fit the pipette pump was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Fit the pipette pump and try again.

nodes.title: Fill the pipette to zero
nodes.description: With the pump, draw the stock from the beaker up to the 0 mark of the pipette.

validation.label: Fill the pipette to zero was completed.

feedback.success: Fill the pipette to zero complete.
feedback.retry: Review Fill the pipette to zero and try again.

nodes.title: Deliver the aliquot
nodes.description: Let the stock run into the flask, then drop by drop, until the meniscus reaches the {{config.aliquotVolumeMl}} mL line.

feedback.retry: Review Deliver the aliquot and try again.

nodes.title: Fill to below the mark
nodes.description: Add deionized water from the wash bottle until the level is just below the mark on the neck.

validation.label: Fill to below the mark was completed.

feedback.success: Fill to below the mark complete.
feedback.retry: Review Fill to below the mark and try again.

nodes.title: Fill a dropping pipette
nodes.description: Draw deionized water from the beaker into the dropping pipette.

validation.label: Fill a dropping pipette was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Fill a dropping pipette and try again.

nodes.title: Bring to the mark
nodes.description: Add water one drop at a time until the bottom of the meniscus touches the mark at eye level.

validation.label: Bring to the mark was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Bring to the mark and try again.

nodes.title: Stopper the flask
nodes.description: Seat the stopper firmly in the neck of the flask.

feedback.retry: Review Stopper the flask and try again.

nodes.title: Invert to mix
nodes.description: Holding the stopper in place, turn the flask upside down and back about ten times.

feedback.retry: Review Invert to mix and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate the dilution factor
nodes.description: Calculate the dilution factor: the final volume divided by the aliquot volume.

validation.label: Calculate the dilution factor was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate the dilution factor and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate the diluted concentration
nodes.description: Calculate the concentration of the diluted solution from the stock concentration and the dilution.

validation.label: Calculate the diluted concentration was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate the diluted concentration and try again.
